summary: This note describes Face of a Fighter, an album by country singer Willie Nelson. The album was recorded in 1961 but was not released until 1978, the year Nelson founded his own label company, Lone Star Records.
one_line: Face of a Fighter is a Willie Nelson album recorded in 1961 and released in 1978 on his own label, Lone Star Records.
key_facts: Face of a Fighter is an album by country singer Willie Nelson.
